# Reconcile PR Compiles

The reconcile function processes merged pull requests to update the compile summary while ensuring that already processed changes are not recompiled. It helps maintain an accurate and updated representation of the code state in response to pull requests.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
